item.title: [−1] India–EU trade deal timeline brings medical-device tariff relief closer as the US interim deal stays stuck
item.description:
Hospitals expect lower tariffs on imported medical technology under the EU pact. The interim US deal remains stuck despite talks. Mixed.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — US tariffs persist

Why it matters: An EU deal would open a large export market and lower import costs for healthcare; delay with the US keeps tariffs on Indian goods.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Indian exporters face rising freight and input costs alongside tariffs in 2026
item.description:
Freight is up about 130% since February and US tariffs remain. Ongoing squeeze.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Margin squeeze

Why it matters: Higher costs and tariffs erode export margins, weighing on manufacturing growth and the trade balance.
